versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json for metadata and references/camera-and-styles.md with camera/style notes.
- Expanded modes to include "Text-only," multi-segment stitching (>15s videos), and scenario-specific strategies.
- Added comprehensive section on IP/copyright avoidance and moderation-safe prompting.
- Introduced detailed best practices for dialogue, sound separation, and reference image style matching.
- Enhanced and clarified special-case instructions (e.g., multi-segment production, product ads, long tracking shots).

Seedance 2.0 JiMeng Skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a robust prompt engineering workflow for Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 Fast with multimodal (image, video, audio, text) support.
- Defines strict mode declaration, asset mapping, and timecoded beat structuring rules for high prompt control.
- Establishes clear platform and input limits for assets and media types.
- Provides a standardized output prompt skeleton to ensure clarity and reproducibility.
- Includes guidance for special cases such as video extension, character replacement, and beat synchronization.
- Adds reference files and local testing helpers for developers.
